description: Clean up constants/projects.ts, add the Zeeshan Utils project with logo, show its run command on the detail page via a minimal copyable code block, and add Vercel rewrite/headers for /utils.
steps: constants/projects.ts: githubUrl values are already quoted strings and slugs are already 'nakhra-store' and 'orienta-notes'; leave them as-is. Remove the line `import { siteConfig } from "@/constants/site";` because nothing in the file uses siteConfig (confirm with a search of the file first).
types/project.ts: add one optional field `command?: string;` to the Project interface (needed so the detail page can render the run command as a code block). Do not change other fields.

constants/projects.ts: append a third entry using the same key order as existing entries: slug "zeeshan-utils", logo "/assets/projects/zeeshan-utils.svg", title "Zeeshan Utils", subtitle "A Windows utility for apps, tweaks and fixes", description stating it is a Windows utility for installing programs, applying tweaks and fixing common problems, forked from Chris Titus Tech's WinUtil (MIT license), technologies ["PowerShell", "WPF", "XAML", "winget", "Git"], features array that MUST include (a) a feature line with the run command text: open PowerShell as administrator and run: irm https://zeeshanxbuilds.tech/utils | iex, and (b) a credit line to ChrisTitusTech/winutil (e.g. 'Forked from ChrisTitusTech/winutil, used under the MIT license.'), plus 1-2 short descriptive features (installing programs via winget, applying tweaks and fixes). Add command: "irm https://zeeshanxbuilds.tech/utils | iex" and githubUrl "https://github.com/zeeshanxbuilds/zeeshan-utils".

featured decision: the homepage ProjectGrid (components/core/projects/ProjectGrid.tsx) is a 2-column grid (sm:grid-cols-2), so three featured projects leave a single orphan card on the second row. Because the layout does not work cleanly with three featured items, set featured: false on the new entry (keep the key explicitly to match the existing schema). Do not change ProjectGrid or FeaturedProjectsSection.

Create public/assets/projects/zeeshan-utils.svg as a single-line SVG identical in structure to public/assets/projects/bookstore.svg (64x64, rect rx=14 fill=#e7e5e4, text x=32 y=40 text-anchor=middle font-family=Arial,sans-serif font-size=24 font-weight=700 fill=#44403c) with the initials ZU, ending with a trailing newline like the existing file.

Create components/shared/CodeBlock.tsx: a minimal "use client" component (pattern: components/layout/ThemeToggle.tsx) taking a `code: string` prop. Render a <pre><code> with the command in a monospace font, styled with existing Tailwind tokens (rounded-xl, border border-border, bg-muted, text-[13px], overflow-x-auto), and a <button type="button"> that calls navigator.clipboard.writeText(code), shows 'Copied' for ~2 seconds then reverts to 'Copy', has an accessible label (aria-label) and an aria-live="polite" status for the copied state, and handles clipboard failure gracefully (catch, no crash). Use React useState/useEffect only; no new libraries. Clear any timeout on unmount.

app/projects/[slug]/page.tsx: when project.command is set, render a small section (e.g. heading 'Run it' or 'Quick Start' with the same font-serif text-xl font-semibold style as 'Key Features', plus a one-line muted text 'Open PowerShell as administrator and run:') containing <CodeBlock code={project.command} />. Place it after the GitHub button block and before the Key Features/Tech Stack grid. Pages without command must render exactly as before.

vercel.json: keep every existing key and value ($schema, framework, installCommand, buildCommand, outputDirectory, cleanUrls) and add: "rewrites": [{ "source": "/utils", "destination": "/winutil.ps1" }] and "headers": [ { "source": "/utils", "headers": [ {"key": "Content-Type", "value": "text/plain; charset=utf-8"}, {"key": "Cache-Control", "value": "public, max-age=0, must-revalidate"}, {"key": "X-Content-Type-Options", "value": "nosniff"} ] }, { "source": "/winutil.ps1", "headers": [ {"key": "Content-Type", "value": "text/plain; charset=utf-8"}, {"key": "Cache-Control", "value": "public, max-age=0, must-revalidate"} ] } ]. Validate the file parses as JSON (e.g. Get-Content vercel.json -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json).

Confirm no app route conflicts with /utils: verify there is no app/utils directory, no app/utils.* file, and no public/utils file or folder. app/sitemap.ts already maps every project, so no edit is needed there; verify after build that out/sitemap.xml contains projects/zeeshan-utils.
Do NOT read, open, edit, move, copy or execute any winutil.ps1 file (neither public/winutil.ps1 nor the untracked winutil.ps1 at the repo root). Do not edit README.md.
Run npm run lint and npm run build; fix any errors in the files you changed.

After build, check: Test-Path out\winutil.ps1 (expected False because the user's script sits at the repo root, not in public/; report this, do not fix it), Test-Path out\projects\zeeshan-utils.html, and that out\projects\zeeshan-utils.html contains the command text.

Run with a shell-local override (do not change git config): $env:GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL='NUL'; git status --short; git diff --stat. Record both outputs in findings. Note that git diff --stat does not list untracked new files (CodeBlock.tsx, zeeshan-utils.svg); list them from git status.
